opening.argument: The presentation ties cryptocurrency accumulation and financial freedom to selling mining equipment and participating in pools, rather than offering a neutral explanation of blockchain technology. It tells viewers to “sell equipment and accumulate,” presents recruitment of at least five new people into the webinar as a qualification or advancement criterion, and urges participation in the BitClub Network. The financial appeal is reinforced by an unusually specific and rapid promise: viewers who dedicate themselves could do what they want because they would be financially free by May 2019. Taken together, these statements promote paid mining participation and a multi-person recruitment structure, using strong wealth and urgency claims to encourage participation without establishing broader losses or outcomes.
